meaning:
Ἑλληνίς
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:8 A * ;]
a Greek (i.e. Gentile) woman: Mrk.7:26, Act.17:12.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
